caption:
When you mountain bike in Costa Rica, you quickly learn that our mountain roads don't compromise on gradients. I have spent years racing and scouting these ridges, finding the exact point where a grueling climb turns into a quiet, rewarding descent. Every route we design at My Adventure Costa Rica is tested right here, on the terrain that keeps us honest.
